https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/horsetooth-reservoir (read in a browser; plain HTTP gets 403)

values.note: 59 electric and 17 full-hookup sites, mostly pull-through (equipment 30-90 ft), plus 2 walk-to sites. The reservoir's boat-in sites, South Bay cabins and Inlet Bay Campground are booked separately.

sites.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/camping/horsetooth-reservoir/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710105 (loop 'South Bay Campground': '78 matching site(s) found'; 59 'STANDARD ELECTRIC', 17 'STANDARD FULL HOOKUP', 2 'WALK TO'; Equip length/Driveway 30-90 ft, mostly 'Pull-Through'), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: larimercamping.com campsiteDetails, South Bay Campground (STANDARD FULL HOOKUP sites: 'Full Hookup: 50', 'Water Hookup: Y', sewer; STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: 'Electricity Hookup: 50' only), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/camping/horsetooth-reservoir/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710105 ('Status: Open year round.') + https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/horsetooth-reservoir ('Horsetooth Reservoir requires entrance and camping permits, and is open year round'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation and a park entrance permit are required before setting up at any site; same-day reservations online, by phone (1-800-397-7795) or by QR code at the site. A no-show unannounced within 24 hours may lose the site (call 970-619-4570). Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/camping/horsetooth-reservoir/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710105 ('Same-day Camping reservations can be made online 24/7, by calling 1-800-397-7795 ... Campers MUST make a reservation and purchase a park entrance permit BEFORE setting up at any campsite'; 'No Shows: If you do not show up within 24 hours ...'; 'Check In: Noon ... Check Out: 11 AM'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Electric sites April-September $35 weekdays, $45 weekends, $55 holidays; October-March $25/$30. Full hookups $45/$60/$65 in summer, $30/$35 in winter. Plus the $8.75 reservation fee and a daily entrance permit ($10 a vehicle, $20 with a boat trailer). Dump station use $15.

fees.source: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/permits (Camping Prices, Horsetooth: 'Electric campsite (April – September) $35 $45 $55', '(October – March) $25 $30', 'Full hookups campsite – Horsetooth Reservoir (April – September) $45 $60 $65', '(October – March) $30 $35'; 'Reservation fee: $8.75 per site, per camping trip'; 'Horsetooth reservoirs $10/vehicle ... $20/vehicle and boat trailer'; 'RV dump stations will charge a $15 fee'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Water only at frost-free spigots November-March; full-hookup hoses may be connected only while filling tanks then.

facilities.source: larimercamping.com campsiteDetails, South Bay ('Drinking water and vault restrooms are located in each campground. Water available at frost free spigots only from Nov-March (tentative)'; 'FULL HOOK UP SITES NOVEMBER 1–APRIL 30: ... water spigots in full hook-up sites may only be used temporarily while filling water storage tanks') + park page ('RV dump stations will cost $15 per session'), read 2026-10-27

note: Larimer County campground at the south end of Horsetooth Reservoir west of Fort Collins (County Road 38E, South Bay entrance), 5,430 ft. Electric sites in shoreline clusters; the full-hookup sites sit on a loop set back from the water. --Claude
summary: larimercamping.com South Bay loop (78 sites, every site type) + site pages + Larimer County permits page: confirmed 50 A, full hookups (17 sites) with water/sewer, pull-throughs, vault toilets, dump, $8.75 reservation fee, year-round. Count 150 (whole reservoir incl. Inlet Bay, boat-in, cabins) -> 78; max 70 -> 90; fees 35-60 -> $35-45 electric + full-hookup $10 (weekend FH $60 and holiday/winter rates in note).
